description: Spring Boot REST Controller for managing answers related to questions in a PostgreSQL-backed application.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: REST Controller handling CRUD operations for Answer entities associated with questions.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Fetches list of answers for a specific question.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Adds a new answer to a specified question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Updates an existing answer for a question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Deletes an answer based on answer and question IDs.
